name: bugbanisher
description: A spooky, human-in-the-loop bug fixer for GitHub. Finds bugs, explains them, and opens a pull request only after you approve.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc -p tsconfig.api.json
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
